retainedFailures: Firefox cross-world typed-array subarray failed on file uploads; indexed copying fixed it. A FileReader experiment was removed.
Firefox header modification ordering required a blocking redirect observer instead of Chromium Location removal.
Native Edge exposed cookies on anonymous XHR; scoped Cookie/Set-Cookie removal and seeded native regressions fixed it.
A queued review close event closed a subsequent dialog; the open-state guard passed final Chrome/Edge/Firefox installation checks.
Chrome completed all 54 helper-suite checks, then a later dependency UI frame wait timed out. Final core checks ran headlessly; the failed overall attempt remains recorded.

Two Firefox full runs reached 273 functional checks but failed the unchanged console assertion on two content.js Conduits RuntimeMessage unload diagnostics. The final run records per-stage console snapshots and passes all 275 checks without suppressing any errors. This intermittent browser teardown behavior is not claimed fixed.
limitations: Safe offline fixtures do not establish live-site compatibility or full Violentmonkey parity.
Ordering is native start order within a timing phase; legacy storage hydration and asynchronous work may complete later.
Downloads remain buffered, capped and non-streaming; files above 16 MiB are unsupported.

Chrome helper-stage source predates only the final permission-removal predicate and review-dialog close fix. Both changes are covered by final core/unit tests and the final Firefox full run; Edge helper stage uses final production hashes.
